# Part

- Inherits [`BasePart`](basepart.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Part")`

A part whose shape is one of the built-in solids: a block, a ball, a cylinder, a capsule or a wedge.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Shape` | `Enum.PartShape` | — | read/write | Which built-in solid this part is. The shape sets both what is drawn and what collides.<br><br>`Size` is the full extent of the shape. A `Ball` is a sphere whose diameter is the largest of the three sizes. A `Cylinder` and a `Capsule` stand along the Y axis: their diameter is the larger of X and Z, and their height, including the caps, is Y. A capsule's drawn shape matches its collision shape exactly when `Size.y` is twice `Size.x`.<br><br>A `Wedge` is a ramp whose tall face points toward -Z. It collides as its whole box, not as a ramp. |
